description: The plot illustrates an "Ablation Study on HateXplain," comparing different performance metrics across various model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and displays categorical data consisting of "Full Model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 58 to 66 at intervals of 2 units. The "Precision" metric is represented by a solid light purple line with circular markers; it starts at 65.45 for the Full Model, drops to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", continues to rise to 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and ends with an upward trend extending beyond the top of the visible y-axis range for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" metric is shown as a solid light blue line with circular markers, beginning at a peak of 65.78 for the Full Model, decreasing to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", increasing to a local peak of 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", dropping to 59.17 for "w/o Attention", and ending at its lowest point of 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Finally, the "F1-score" metric is depicted by a solid tan line with circular markers, starting at its highest value of 65.56 for the Full Model, declining to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rising to 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", decreasing to 59.67 for "w/o Attention", and ending at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
